name: Streaming
summary: Apache Kafka (KRaft, single node), PySpark 3.5 Structured Streaming and PostgreSQL for real-time pipeline projects.

services.name: workspace
services.purpose: Your development container: Python 3.12, Java 17, PySpark, Kafka client, JupyterLab

services.name: kafka
services.purpose: Single-node Kafka broker in KRaft mode (no ZooKeeper)

services.name: postgres
services.purpose: Relational database used as a streaming sink

reset.label: Reset topics and the database
reset.command: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait

limitations: One Kafka broker with replication factor 1: good for learning, not for testing fault tolerance.
Spark runs in local mode. The first Kafka-connected Spark session downloads the spark-sql-kafka connector from Maven Central.
Kafka and Postgres are reachable only from the workspace (hosts `kafka:9092`, `postgres:5432`).
